title: The Music Box and the piano players: Horace Diaz and Frank Bonero

blocks.x: I know the name, I never met him. I never met him.

He used to be a salesman for the Con Company when they were down on, on Coronelette Street, right off the canal across the street from the Music Box. Remember the Music Box where it was? Again, another name. Upstairs, upstairs.

That's where we got our education in piano playing. Really? And faking. There was three piano players down there. Piano player never stopped. So they had to hire extra piano players. Okay. Was he, uh, Noem was well enough. Did he play with Johnny Wiggs, Johnny Honigman? No, uh-uh.
Yeah, he went to New York. He became, well, he became, he later became the second piano for the famous piano player, the orchestra leader. Oh, shit. Better than Horace Diaz? That's, that's his name.
How did you get that? Well, you described him. Well, you did a good job of describing it. He was an arranger, he was an arranger. Horace Diaz.
